title: Russian Emigrants Club

page_data.en:
Police Uncover Large-Scale
Gambling Den In Russian Club

Energetic investigations pursued
by the local Police, following in-
formation received, resulted in the
sensational discovery of a large-
scale gambling den, which has for
some time been operated at the
premises occupied by a Russian club
at 147 Weihaiwei Road, Central
Press reports.
The establishment, which has been
operated on a lavish scale under
the direction of one Wang Mow-
Ting, included facilities for numer-
ous games of chance, both Chinese
and foreign.
The operators of the establishment,
learning that the Police authorities
had got wind of their illegal activi-
ties, resorted to bribery and ap-
proached the Chief of the Sin-Chen
Police Station, Li Kuo-Hua, who
was offered a gift of $300,000.
Police Chief Li, however, proved
infallible to the temptation and re-
ported the matter to his superior
authorities. As a result preparations
were made for a raid on the estab-
lishment, which was successfully car-
ried out on Saturday.
Masquerading as patrons of the
establishment, picked members of the
Police entered the gambling den on
Saturday evening and there carried
out a strict supervision over the
movement of the operators of the
joint. Later in the evening Wang
Mow-Ting, the principal operator, ac-
companied by two of his chief as-
sistants, one of whom has been as-
certained to be his own son, left the
premises and were immediately ap-
prehended by police officers who were
waiting outside and taken to the Sin-
Cheng Police Station on Chengtu
Road.
At the police station Wang confess-
ed his crime, revealing that he had
put up a capital of $6,000,000 for the
operation of the gambling establish-
ment after an agreement with the
Russian club authorities, who placed
the premises at his disposal.
Following this confession Chief Li
of the Sin-Cheng Police Station, after
consultation with officials of the
Municipal Police Bureau, carried out
a raid on the premises the same
evening.
The raid resulted in the arrest of
174 persons, among whom were a few
Japanese, French, Portuguese, Spanish,
Indian, Danish and Russian nationals,
besides Chinese nationals who con-
stituted the majority of the patrons.
A large quantity of gambling para-
phernalia was also seized during the
raid.
An employee of the establishment,
who attempted to evade arrest by
jumping over the wall of the build-
ing, met with an accident and was
sent to a hospital, it was added.

NOTICE

THE public is hereby notified
that the Russian Club,
1053 Avenue Foch, established
in 1934, has nothing in com-
mon with the so-called Rus-
sian Club, 147 Weihaiwei
Road.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS.
1-3-45 905

Russian Emigre
Head Detained

As an aftermath of the police raid
last week at the Russian Club, 147
Weihaiwei Road, in which 174 persons
were taken into custody for gambling,
two more Russians, F. L. Cleboff,
chairman of the Russian Club, and
B. Sverjensky, a prominent member
of the local White Russian commun-
ity, have been arrested by the police.
It was learnt yesterday that the
two men will shortly be brought be-
fore the court to face trial on their
gambling activities.
Cleboff, it was reported, is the re-
cognized leader of the local White
Russians, being the chairman of the
local Russian Emigre Committee.

警方在俄国人俱乐部查获大型赌场

据《中央日报》报道，当地警方根据所获情报展开积极调查，结果轰动性地发现了一处大型赌场。该赌场长期以来一直在威海卫路147号一家俄国人俱乐部所占用的场所内经营。

该场所由一名叫王茂庭（音译）的人指挥，规模奢华，设有多种中西式博彩设施。

该场所的经营者在得知警方当局已察觉其非法活动后，采取贿赂手段，接触新成警察局（Sin-Chen Police Station）局长李国华（Li Kuo-Hua），向其提供30万美元的“礼物”。

然而，李局长不为诱惑所动，将此事上报上级当局。因此，警方制定了突袭该场所的计划，并于周六成功执行。

周六晚间，精选的警员伪装成该场所的顾客进入赌场，对团伙经营者的行动进行了严密监控。当晚稍后，主要经营者王茂庭（音译）在其两名主要助手的陪同下离开该场所，其中一人经查实为其亲生儿子。他们立即被在外等候的警员逮捕，并被带往成都路的新成警察局（Sin-Cheng Police Station）。

在警察局，王承认了其罪行，透露在与俄国人俱乐部当局达成协议、后者将场所交由其使用后，他投入了600万元资金用于经营该赌博场所。

在此供认之后，新成警察局局长李在与工部局警务处官员协商后，于当晚对该场所实施了突袭。

此次突袭导致174人被捕，其中包括少数日本、法国、葡萄牙、西班牙、印度、丹麦和俄国国籍人士，此外还有构成顾客大多数的中国籍人士。

突袭期间还缴获了大量赌博用具。

另据悉，该场所的一名雇员试图跳墙逃避逮捕，结果发生意外，被送往医院。

公告

特此通知公众，福煦路1053号成立于1934年的俄国人俱乐部，与所谓的威海卫路147号俄国人俱乐部毫无关联。

董事会。
1-3-45 905

俄国流亡者
首领被拘留

作为上周警方突袭威海卫路147号俄国人俱乐部（174人因赌博被拘留）的后续，另有两名俄国人被警方逮捕，他们是俄国人俱乐部主席F. L. Cleboff，以及当地白俄社区的重要成员B. Sverjensky。

昨日获悉，这两人不久将被带上法庭，就其赌博活动受审。

据报道，Cleboff是当地白俄人的公认领袖，担任当地俄国流亡者委员会主席。

Lee turned him out.

Saturday evening several members of the police force gained admittance to the premises for the purpose of keeping observation on gambling. On seeing them Wong decided to decamp, but was stopped by the police on duty outside the premises and was taken to the station. There he admitted that he was the owner of the den and that he had paid $6,000,000 to those in charge of the club for the use of the premises.

Superintendent Lee issued order to raid the premises.

Police promptly threw a cordon round the premises, entered the club, arrested everybody found there and seized the gambling paraphernalia found. A total of 174 people were arrested, including, according to the Central Press, Japanese, Portuguese, French, Danish, Russian and Chinese nationals. The latter constituted the majority.

Investigations into this matter are being continued.

It is to be expected that charges will be preferred not only against the owners of the gambling den, but also those in charge of the "cultural" centre, who had leased their premises and their name to a person whom they knew to be a notorious gambling den operator."

2. "The NEW LIFE", Soviet daily newspaper,: "ARREST OF F.L.GLEBOFF"

According to yesterday's report of the Chinese newspapers - "Central China Daily News" "Sing Wan Pao", "Sing Pao" , "Sing Shen Pao" and others, the municipal police arrested F.L. Gleboff, Chairman of the "Russian Club" and head of the Russian emigrant community in Shanghai, and B. Svergensky - manager of the "Russian Club".

Both were arrested in connection with the smashing by the police of a gambling den in the premises of the "Russian Club", 147 Weihaiwei Road.

A few days ago Chengtu Road Police Station, having received information to the effect that a gambling den functions in the premises of the "Russian Club", entered the premises in question and arrested Fan Mao-ting, owner of the den, and principal manager of the den- a certain Han Hwa Ching.. At the same time some 174 people - employees and visitors of the club, were arrested. This number included Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, Indian, French and other nationals.

Police investigation ascertained that directors of the club - F.L/Gleboff, Chairman of the "Russian Club" ( Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee ) and B.Svergensky and others had leased the pre-

李将其驱逐。

周六晚间，几名警员进入该场所，目的是监视赌博活动。Wong见到他们后决定逃跑，但在场所外被执勤警察拦下，并被带到警局。在那里，他承认自己是该赌窟的所有者，并已向俱乐部负责人支付600万元以使用该场所。

李督察下令突袭该场所。

警方迅速包围该场所，进入俱乐部，逮捕了现场所有人，并缴获了发现的赌博用具。共计174人被捕，据《中央日报》称，其中包括日本、葡萄牙、法国、丹麦、俄国和中国国籍人士。后者占大多数。

对此事的调查仍在继续。

预计不仅会对赌窟所有者提出指控，还会对那些“文化”中心的负责人提出指控，因为他们将场所和名义租给了一个他们明知是臭名昭著的赌窟经营者的人。”

2. 《新生活报》（"THE NEW LIFE"），苏联日报：“F.L.GLEBOFF被捕”

根据昨日中文报纸——《华中日报》、《星晚报》、《星报》、《申报》等——的报道，工部局警务处逮捕了“俄国人俱乐部”主席、上海俄国流亡者社区首领F.L. Gleboff，以及“俄国人俱乐部”经理B. Svergensky。

两人均因警方捣毁位于威海卫路147号“俄国人俱乐部”场所内的赌窟而被捕。

几天前，成都路警察局收到情报，称“俄国人俱乐部”场所内有赌窟运作，遂进入该场所，逮捕了赌窟所有者范茂庭（音译）及主要经理韩华清（Han Hwa Ching，音译）。同时，约174名俱乐部员工和访客被捕。这些人中包括中国、日本、俄国、葡萄牙、印度、法国及其他国籍人士。

警方调查查明，俱乐部董事——“俄国人俱乐部”主席（俄国流亡者委员会主席）F.L./Gleboff，以及B.Svergensky等人已将相关场

4. The "NEW TIMES", March 3, 1945. Mr. K.Kuroki, Editor & Publisher.

FALSE REPORT REGARDING GENERAL GLEBOFF'S ARREST.

Some of the local Chinese newspapers published recetly an ob-
viously invented report to the effect that by order of the local
police authorities was detained F.L. Gleboff, Chairman of the Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee.

We are in the position to state that F.L. Gleboff was not sub-
jected to any arrest or detention whatsoever and that continues
to carry out the duties of Chairman of the Russian Emigrants Commit-
tee, paying much attention tothe rendering of relief to the poorer
part of the Russian community through the Special Economic Coun-
cil.

It is to be regretted that one of the local newspapers publish-
ed in the Russian language and claiming to be a sound press organ,
published false report of some Chinese press under a head line in
bold type, containing sensational report of a nature obviously cal-
culated to create a cheap effect.".

所以每月600万元的金额租给了一名叫王茂庭（Wang Mau Ting）的人。

这一情况导致F.L.Gleboff、B.Svergensky及其他数人被捕。

3. 《晚霞报》（"VECHERNIAYA ZARIA"），1945年2月26日

该报纸仅翻译了1945年2月26日的《字林西报》（"Shanghai Times"）关于此主题的报道。

4. 《新时代》（"NEW TIMES"），1945年3月3日。编辑兼出版人：K.Kuroki先生。

关于Gleboff将军被捕的虚假报道。

当地一些中文报纸最近刊登了一篇明显捏造的报道，称当地警方当局下令拘留了俄国流亡者委员会主席F.L. Gleboff。

我们要声明，F.L. Gleboff并未受到任何逮捕或拘留，并继续履行俄国流亡者委员会主席的职责，通过特别经济委员会大力关注向俄国社区贫困部分提供救济。

令人遗憾的是，当地一家自称是可靠新闻机构的俄文报纸，在醒目大标题下刊登了一些中文报纸的虚假报道，其耸人听闻的性质显然是为了制造廉价效应。”
